title: Keep the claim small enough.
prompt: What has the previous calculation established?
hint: A counterexample refutes the particular universal property it targets.

options.text: The map x ↦ x² is nonlinear on ℝ; nothing about chaos follows from that fact alone.

feedback.pass: Nonlinearity is a structural property. It is not a certificate of complexity or chaos.
feedback.fail: The calculation concerns superposition for x², not the long-run behavior of every nonlinear system.
